From the moment it was first conceived, our designers had no intention
of making the Hyundai Genesis a “copy cat” luxury sedan. They wanted
to push the Genesis concept further. With elegantly chiseled forms that
convey the car’s strength and power. With striking design aesthetics that
interpret the luxury sedan as both progressive and timeless – soothing,
yet capable of stirring the soul.
Nobody expected Genesis to challenge the automotive elite right out
of the gate. But it did, earning North American Car of the Year honors
upon its unveiling. Gratifying? No doubt. But we view this less as an
acknowledgement of our achievement as we do a testament to our
potential.
The 2012 Genesis luxury sport sedan takes the best of our ideas forward
with refined styling and an entirely new level of power and performance.
All from a company that, in a few short years, has harnessed the
horsepower of some of the world’s most imaginative engineering minds.
And unleashed it to once again impress the automotive elite with a
luxury car that is as admired as any brand smart money can buy.
